digest.component_or_area: Git version enforcement and test gating
propositions: Git 2.38+ floor must be declared, enforced, and consistently documented across contributor and CI contexts rather than guarded with runtime skips that risk test vacuity
The merge-tree regression test (added for bug 8185) must execute on every gating CI environment without conditional skip paths, verified by fail-closed guards that search the entire test tree
The floor enforcement mechanism must abort the entire pytest session before collection with a diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, required capability, and upgrade path
Documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, local-dev-env.md) and CI workflows must single-source the Git floor declaration to prevent drift
Non-vacuity checks must fail loudly if the merge-tree regression is guarded with skip/xfail machinery or if the capability probe is removed
